subject.title: fix: stop selected channel sessions from WebChat

question: Should Control UI `/stop` for a selected non-global channel session deliberately discard that session’s queued follow-up and lane work, or should it preserve queued work after cancelling only the active run?
rationale: Both behaviors are plausible, but they differ in user-visible message-delivery semantics and cannot be resolved mechanically from the existing abort API or tests.

options.title: Adopt queue-clearing stop semantics
options.body: Keep the explicit `clearQueued: true` UI path and document `/stop` as cancelling the active selected session plus its queued successor work.

options.title: Preserve queued work
options.body: Keep session-scoped active-run cancellation but remove the UI opt-in to `clearQueued`, leaving queue removal to an explicit future action.

options.title: Pause for narrower UX design
options.body: Hold the PR until maintainers define separate visible controls or language for stopping active work versus discarding queued work.

recommendation.title: Adopt queue-clearing stop semantics
recommendation.body: Keep the explicit `clearQueued: true` UI path and document `/stop` as cancelling the active selected session plus its queued successor work.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice changes durable Control UI and Gateway product semantics across multiple ownership boundaries.
